verses: Aey nabi! (apni ummat say kaho kay) jab tum apni biwiyon ko tallaq dena chahao to unn ki iddat (kay dino kay aaghaaz) mein unhen tallaq do aur iddat ka hisab rakho, aur Allah say jo tumhara perwerdigar hai dartay raho, na tum unhen unn kay gharon say nikalo aur na woh (khud) niklen haan yeh aur baat hai kay woh khulli buraee ker bethen, yeh Allah ki muqarrar kerdah hadden hain, jo shakhs Allah ki haddon say aagay barh jaye uss ney yaqeenan apney upper zulm kiya, tum nahi jantay shayad uss kay baad Allah Taalaa koi naee baat peda ker dey

Pus jab yeh aurten apni iddat poori kerney kay qareeb phonch jayen to unhen ya to qaeeday kay mutabiq apney nikkah mein rehney do ya dastoor kay mutabiq unhen alag ker do aur aapas mein say do aadil shakhson ko gawah ker lo aur Allah ki razamandi kay liye theek theek gawahi do. Yehi hai woh jiss ki naseehat ussay ki jati hai jo Allah per aur qayamat kay din per eman rakhta ho aur jo shakhs Allah say darta hai Allah uss kay liye chutkaray ki shakal nikal deta hai

Aur ussay aisi jagah say rozi deta hai jiss ka ussay guman bhi na ho aur jo shakhs Allah per tawakkal keray ga Allah ussay kafi hoga. Allah Taalaa apna kaam poora kerkay hi rahey ga. Allah Taalaa ney her cheez ka aik andaza muqarrar ker rakha hai

Tumhari aurton mein say jo aurten haiz say na-umeed ho gaee hun, agar tumhen shuba)yeh ho to unn ki iddat teen maheeney hai aur unn ki bhi jinhen haiz aana shuroo hi na hua ho aur hamila aurton ki iddat unn kay waza hamal hai aur jo shakhs Allah Taalaa say daray ga Allah uss kay (her) kaam mein aasani ker dey ga
Yeh Allah ka hukum hai jo uss ney tumhari taraf utara hai aur jo shakhs Allah say daray ga Allah uss kay gunah mita dey ga aur ussay bara bhari ajar dey ga

Tum apni taqat kay mutabiq jahan tum rehtay ho o haan unn (tallaq wali) aurton ko rakho aur unhen tang kerney kay liye takleef na phonchao aur agar woh hamal say hun to jab tak bacha peda ho ley unhen kharach detay raha kero phir agar tumharay kehney say o hi doodh pilayen to tum unhen unn ki ujrat dey do aur bahum munasib tor per mashwara ker liya kero aur agar tum aapas mein kash-ma-kash kero to uss kay kehney say koi aur doodh pilaye gi

Kushadgi walay ko apni kushadgi say kharach kerna chahaiye aur jiss per uss kay rizq ki tangi ki gaee ho ussay chahaiye kay jo kuch Allah Taalaa ney ussay dey rakha hai ussi mein say (apni hasb-e-aadat heysiyat) dey, kissi shakhs ko Allah takleef nahi deta magar itni hi jitni taqat ussay dey rakhi hai, Allah tangi kay baad aasani faraghat bhi ker dey ga
Aur boht si basti walon ney apney rab kay hukum say aur uss kay rasoolon say sirtabi ki to hum ney bhi unn say sakht hisab kiya aur unhen azab diya unn dekha (sakht) azab
Pus unhon ney apney kartoot ka maza chakh liya aur anjam kaar unn ka khasarah hi hua
Unn kay liye Allah Taalaa ney sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai, pus Allah say daro aey aqal mand eman walo. Yaqeenan Allah ney tumhari taraf naseehat utaar di hai

(yani) rasool jo tumhen Allah kay saaf saaf ehkaam parh sunata hai takay unn logon ko jo eman layen aur nek amal keren woh tareekiyon say roshni ki taraf ley aaye, aur jo shakhs Allah per eman laye aur nek amal keray Allah ussay aisi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jiss kay neechay nehren jari hain jin mein yeh hamesha hamesha rahen gay. Be-shak Allah ney ussay behtareen rozi dey rakhi hai

Allah woh hai jiss ney saat aasman banaye aur ussi kay misil zaminen bhi. Uss ka hukum unn kay darmiyan utarta hai takay tum jaan lo kay Allah her cheez per qadir hai. Aur Allah Taalaa ney her cheez ko ba aitbaar ilm gher rakha hai
